purpose: Declared screen of the confidence-preserving variant of the partial_reuse arm. Mechanism measured on clip A of the first screen: reused finals carried stt_confidence=None, so ~15 finals per run left the sub-second Marian route for Gemma; that extra Gemma work regressed the first-token and cut-final p95 tails and shrank the all-silence median gain to −6 %/0 %. The variant keeps the partial's STT confidence so should_use_marian_only decides as for a full-STT final. Behaviour-changing arm: 15 % median gate on the Gemma-routed AND the all-silence cohorts, tails on both screened metrics, text guards; opt-in; no default change.
checkout: /Users/willem/Code/vibes/SRTranslate-wt-p2b (codex/series4-p2-reuse-confidence = codex/series4-p2-reuse @ 56a045b + partial_reuse_keep_confidence; commit recorded at launch)
design: per clip: ctl,reuse300c,reuse300c,ctl,ctl,reuse300c (3 repeats each, alternating); 12 runs; one inference process at a time; 300 ms chosen because it reuses ~90 % of silence finals (100 ms: ~62 %) and stayed within the 3 % text guards on clip A of the first screen

gates.G_median: Gemma-routed silence-final first-token p50 AND speech_end_to_final_ms p50 improve >= 15 % vs control on BOTH clips, AND all-silence speech_end_to_final_ms p50 improves >= 15 % on both clips (the route mix must not be the source of the gain)
gates.G_tail: no p95 regression beyond max(5 %, 100 ms) on first-token (Gemma-silence, all-silence) and speech_end_to_final_ms (Gemma-silence, all-silence, all finals); the tool G2 cuts p95 rule is reported
gates.G_preview: preview count within 2 pp of control per clip
gates.G_text: pooled English WER of candidate finals vs control finals <= 3 % and concatenated Spanish WER <= 3 % per clip; bad_split count not above control; every differing final listed
gates.G_memory: Metal peak within max(5 %, 1 GiB) of control (relative rule)
gates.reported_not_gated: final_stt_reused_partial / final_stt_full counters, reuse share of silence finals, final STT p50, cut finals unchanged

outcome_rule: PASS (both arms judged separately) = qualified for an attended confirmation with visible ACKs and a human review of the listed text differences -> PR #218 auto-merge enabled (flag stays off by default); REJECTED otherwise -> PR left open with the numbers
